wikidot5e:spell:fear.effectSummary: Each creature in a 30-foot cone makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it drops what it is holding and is frightened for the duration. While frightened this way, on each turn it must Dash away from you by the safest available route unless there is nowhere to move. If it ends a turn where it no longer has line of sight to you, it repeats the Wisdom save and ends the spell on itself on a success.

wikidot5e:spell:feeblemind.effectSummary: One visible creature in range takes 4d6 psychic damage and makes an Intelligence save. On a failure, its Intelligence and Charisma become 1; it cannot cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, or communicate intelligibly, although it still recognizes, follows, and can protect its friends. At the end of every 30 days it repeats the Intelligence save, ending the spell on a success. Greater restoration, heal, or wish also ends it.

wikidot5e:spell:feign-death.effectSummary: A willing creature you touch enters a state indistinguishable from death for 1 hour or until you use an action to touch it and dismiss the spell. It appears dead to outward inspection and magic used to determine its status, is blinded and incapacitated, has speed 0, and has resistance to all damage except psychic. Diseases and poisons affecting it, or acquired during the spell, have no effect until the spell ends.

wikidot5e:spell:find-familiar.effectSummary: Summon a spirit in the form of a bat, cat, crab, frog or toad, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, quipper, rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel; it uses that form's statistics but is a celestial, fey, or fiend. It obeys you, rolls its own initiative, and cannot attack but can take other actions. At 0 HP it disappears and can return when you cast the spell again. As an action you can temporarily dismiss it to a pocket dimension, permanently dismiss it, or return a temporarily dismissed familiar to an unoccupied space within 30 feet; anything it wore or carried remains behind when it disappears. Within 100 feet you can communicate telepathically and, as an action until your next turn, see and hear through its senses while losing your own sight and hearing. You can have only one familiar; recasting while one exists can instead change its form. When you cast a touch-range spell, a familiar within 100 feet can use its reaction to deliver it, using your attack modifier if an attack roll is required.

wikidot5e:spell:find-greater-steed.effectSummary: Summon a spirit as a griffon, pegasus, peryton, dire wolf, rhinoceros, or saber-toothed tiger in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. It uses that form's statistics but is a celestial, fey, or fiend; if its Intelligence is 5 or lower it becomes 6 and it understands one language you speak. You control it in combat, communicate telepathically within 1 mile, and while mounted can make a spell that targets only you also target the mount. At 0 HP or when dismissed as an action it temporarily disappears, leaving worn or carried objects behind; recasting returns the bonded mount at full HP with conditions removed. You cannot have more than one mount bonded by this spell or find steed at once, and can permanently release the bond as an action.

wikidot5e:spell:find-steed.effectSummary: Summon a spirit as a warhorse, pony, camel, elk, mastiff, or another DM-approved steed in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. It uses the chosen form's statistics but is a celestial, fey, or fiend; if its Intelligence is 5 or lower it becomes 6 and it understands one language you speak. It serves as your mount, and while mounted you can make a spell that targets only you also target it. Within 1 mile you communicate telepathically. At 0 HP or when dismissed as an action it disappears; recasting returns the same steed at full HP. You can have only one steed bonded by this spell at a time and can permanently release the bond as an action.

wikidot5e:spell:find-the-path.effectSummary: For up to 1 day, learn the shortest and most direct physical route to a specific fixed location you know on the same plane. The spell fails for a destination on another plane, a moving destination, or a nonspecific destination. While on the same plane as the destination, you always know its distance and direction; whenever travel presents a choice of paths, you automatically know which is shortest and most direct, though not necessarily safest.

wikidot5e:spell:find-traps.effectSummary: Sense whether any deliberately created trap within line of sight and 120 feet is present. A trap is something intentionally designed to cause a sudden or unexpected harmful or undesirable effect, including alarm, glyph of warding, or a mechanical pit, but not natural hazards such as a weak floor or sinkhole. You learn that a trap is present and the general nature of its danger, but not each trap's location.

wikidot5e:spell:find-vehicle.effectSummary: Summon a spirit as a nonmilitary land vehicle in an unoccupied space within 30 feet for 8 hours. It has the normal vehicle's statistics and a celestial, fey, or fiendish appearance. While driving it, you are proficient with that vehicle type and add double your proficiency bonus to driving-related ability checks; a spell you cast that targets only you can also target the vehicle. It disappears at 0 HP, when dismissed as an action, or when you release the bond as an action, and you can have only one bonded vehicle at a time. A 3rd-level-or-higher slot may instead create a nonmilitary water vehicle carrying six Medium creatures; a 5th-level-or-higher slot may create a nonmilitary air vehicle carrying ten Medium creatures; a 7th-level-or-higher slot may create any vehicle type with DM approval.

wikidot5e:spell:finger-of-death.effectSummary: One visible creature in range makes a Constitution save, taking 7d8+30 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A humanoid killed by this spell rises as a zombie at the start of your next turn and is permanently under your command, following your verbal orders as well as it can.
